end.summary:
- Discussed family members and ways they care for one another.
- Practised examples of household work that any family member can do.
- Trisha named placing plates, putting away books, and putting clothes in the basket as tasks they can do.
- Explained that sharing work helps finish sooner and reduces Mummy’s work.
- Identified some family-tree relationships; the final relationship question was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised why sharing household work matters and how family members can help each other. Trisha gave examples of placing plates, putting away books, putting clothes in the basket, and giving Dadi water; their explanation that shared work helps finish sooner was clear. Trisha first said they were too young to help, but later named several jobs they can do, so this mix-up was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, invite Trisha to choose one small household task and talk about how it helps someone else.
